AccessUpdateRequest.description:
Replaces the allowed departments (ADM-07). An empty list is 422
``ALLOWED_DEPARTMENTS_EMPTY``; the field is not constrained here so the route can return that
stable code (ADM-05).
AccessUpdateRequest.title: AccessUpdateRequest

AdminDocumentList.description: Cursor page in the style of the library list (DOC-01). No total count.
AdminDocumentList.title: AdminDocumentList

AdminErrorBody.description:
The shared error body with the Admin codes of M3 spelled out in the schema, so the
frontend catalog is checked against them at compile time. Other routes keep other codes.
AdminErrorBody.title: AdminErrorBody

DocumentListResponse.description: Cursor page (Q3). ``next_cursor`` is opaque; there is no total count.
DocumentListResponse.title: DocumentListResponse

DocumentMetadata.description: Metadata of one visible document; shares the list item shape.
DocumentMetadata.title: DocumentMetadata

IdentityResponse.description: The current identity (AUTH-09). Returned by every session-creating endpoint too.
IdentityResponse.title: IdentityResponse

ImportEntryPreview.description: One manifest entry as validated by the backend (ADM-12). Nothing was created.
ImportEntryPreview.title: ImportEntryPreview

get.description:
Every non-deleted document with its latest revision status (ADM-02, ADM-09). Needs no
active department (SEC-17 applies to the user routes, not here). Order: newest first.

post.description:
Validate, store in R2, then write document, revision, access, job and outbox in one
transaction (ADM-03). The response is 202: processing continues in the Worker.

delete.description: Soft delete only (ADM-08, OPEN-31 D7). Objects and chunks stay until M5.

patch.description: Replace the allowed departments in one update. No job, no re-embedding (ADM-07).

200.description: Server-sent events for one document. `event: status` carries DocumentProcessingStatus as JSON, sent on connect and on every change. A comment line keeps the connection open. `event: end` carries `{"reason": "terminal" | "timeout"}`; on "timeout" the client reconnects.

post.description:
Replace the file of a document with no current revision whose latest revision failed
(ADM-18). 409 ``DOCUMENT_NOT_REPLACEABLE`` for any other state.
Manual retry (ADM-16). 409 ``DOCUMENT_NOT_RETRYABLE`` for a done or actively leased job.
Partial success is a 200 with per-file results (ADM-14).
Convert the current Demo identity to Registered after a successful credential link.
Verify a fresh Firebase ID token (password or Google) and start a KnowServe session.
Sign out everywhere: revoke every KnowServe session of the current user (AUTH-33).

Start a Demo session from a fresh Firebase anonymous ID token (AUTH-16).

401 ``DEMO_EXPIRED`` when this Demo identity is past its 24 hours.
